searched: Searched 29 October 2026 (web search for discovery only; every passage read from the retrieved text). Mistral AI: mistral.ai news for 2023–2026 rounds; Lightspeed and a16z posts; tech.eu and TechCrunch for the Series A and B, for which no Mistral AI text was located. Inflection AI: inflection.ai blog index (the June 2023 funding release is no longer on the site), Business Wire (refused), TechCrunch; Inflection’s May 2024 and July 2026 posts. Reid Hoffman’s later roles: only Manas AI found (a drug-discovery company; omitted). Microsoft AI: Official Microsoft Blog posts of April 2024 (London hub) and March 2026 (Copilot leadership update); microsoft.ai news and about pages (no leadership roster; no text on Karén Simonyan’s later remit). Hires from Google DeepMind to Microsoft AI (Dominic King, Amar Subramanya and others) were found only in reporting or LinkedIn posts. European and new labs founded by frontier-lab people: Latent Labs press releases; Adaption blog, Emergence Capital post, Wilson Sonsini note; Ineffable Intelligence site, Companies House register, Cooley release, Fortune; Kyutai site and the CMA CGM launch release. The r.jina.ai relay refused all requests from this environment during this pass (HTTP 401, IP reputation), so publishers that need the relay were retrieved directly where possible. Not searched: Black Forest Labs (founders from Stability AI, not a frontier lab in scope), Bioptimus, Reka (founded 2022; already recorded).
